name: scroll-fix
author: rhwski
description: Mouse-wheel scrolling in NPC shop and sell windows (and other lists) moves a fixed number of rows per wheel notch, instead of flying to the bottom.

settings.label: Rows per wheel notch
settings.description: How many list rows one notch of the mouse wheel scrolls (a row is 32 pixels).

settings.label: Wheel notch size
settings.description: How much wheel movement counts as one notch. 100 suits normal wheels. If scrolling is still too fast on a smooth or free-spinning wheel or a touchpad, raise this; if it feels sluggish, lower it.

settings.label: Fix every scrolling list
settings.description: On: inventory, storage and other lists with the client's custom scrollbar behave the same way. Off: only NPC shop and sell windows.
